purpose: Current Issue-12 Week-9 ML/conformal acceptance; not updated notebook outputs and not classical uncertainty acceptance.
tolerance_policy: Absolute half-unit at the four-decimal precision of Notebook-14 calibration/external/residual tables. New point, pinball, paired and severity summaries use that same explicit reporting precision. Only named summary metrics tolerate differences; nominal levels, model configurations, counts, IDs, order and input fingerprints are exact. Environment versions are provenance, not an unconditional gate.

historical_provenance.classification: MATCH at saved four-decimal precision; no unexplained differences.
historical_provenance.interpretation: ML/conformal algorithms unchanged. Residual context uses corrected current classical point fits only; no covariance, classical bootstrap or repeated-Poisson run.

independent_rerun.policy: Exact science summaries and byte-level data/metadata/feature/prediction/attachment/paired/residual-profile fingerprints; elapsed time excluded.

week9_ml.preparation_policy: Stateless features; shared 64-development PCA unused by uncertainty; learned Ridge scaling uses 48 training rows or their bootstrap resamples.

estimator_policy.bootstrap_policy: 48 row draws with replacement per fit; default_rng(42); reference fit supplies point estimate
